title: ACR Authentication and Managed Identity
description: Authenticate with Azure Container Registry using service principals, admin accounts, and managed identity for secure, passwordless access.

data.text: Azure Container Registry supports several authentication methods. For production, managed identity is the recommended approach because it eliminates the need for credentials entirely.

cards.title: Admin Account
cards.description: A built-in admin user with a static username and password.

cards.title: Service Principal
cards.description: An Azure AD application with permissions to pull/push images.

cards.title: Managed Identity
cards.description: An Azure-managed identity for Azure resources (AKS, VMs, App Service).

data.text: When an Azure resource has a managed identity, you can grant it access to ACR without any credentials in code or configuration.

data.title: Azure CLI - Grant AKS Access to ACR via Managed Identity
data.content:
# Get the AKS managed identity client ID
AKS_ID=$(az aks show --resource-group myRG --name myAKS --query identity.principalId -o tsv)

# Get the ACR resource ID
ACR_ID=$(az acr show --name myRegistry --query id -o tsv)

# Grant the AKS identity AcrPull role on the registry
az role assignment create --assignee $AKS_ID --role AcrPull --scope $ACR_ID

data.title: Azure CLI - Login to ACR from a VM with Managed Identity
data.content:
# When running on an Azure VM with a managed identity:
az acr login --name myRegistry
# No credentials needed - the VM's managed identity handles auth

data.title: Managed Identity is Best Practice
data.text: Always use managed identity in production. It eliminates credential sprawl, avoids hardcoded secrets, and automatically rotates tokens. Use admin accounts only for testing.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Managed identity provides passwordless ACR authentication
Assign AcrPull role to the identity accessing the registry
Admin accounts should only be used for development
Service principals offer granular permission control
data.takeaway: Use managed identity for secure, credential-free ACR access in production.
